brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base piece:0,0,0;full closed with top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top, bottom cover cover:0,0,0;full;bottom, and six solid end caps capOpenFaces added on all side faces; lockJoints applied. check_build ok, meshClash clear.

Louvred vent port port:0#0,0#0 (hex-port-louvre, 'Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe') fitted in slot 0 of the enclosure wall, providing airflow while the rest of the enclosure stays closed.
requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so the board inside can breathe

finish.summary: Built a closed single-cell electronics enclosure from the existing full hex base: solid top and bottom covers, all six side faces capped with solid end caps, joints locked. A louvre port (hex-port-louvre) is fitted in one wall slot so air can circulate for the board inside while the enclosure otherwise remains closed. No board prop exists in the catalog, so the interior is left empty for the user's board. check_build passes with meshClash clear.
